2121335180954869846.en_summary: damnang2 had lunch with some $NVDA employees and discussed the situation. Internally people seem reluctant to discuss it, with longtime managers particularly wary of letting this shake the organization, though Blind has plenty of discussion and speculation. The day after Jensen stepped down one group held an all-hands to share what they knew; everyone was concerned about the risks and there was strong interest in whether Jensen could return. Met both longtime employees and recent hires, all supportive of Jensen; some questioned whether the affair allegations were true, could not imagine NVIDIA without him and hoped he would return. Concern about losing longtime employees who valued the purpose under Jensen more than money. Security seemed tighter and guest visits restricted. The visit underscored how much NVIDIA has relied on Jensen's technical leadership; setting aside his personal life, his return would be the best outcome for NVIDIA.
2121335180954869846.zh_summary: damnang2今日與一些$NVDA員工共進午餐並討論情況。內部似乎不願互相討論，多年經理特別警惕讓此事動搖組織，但Blind上有大量討論和猜測。Jensen下台次日一個小組舉行全員會議公開分享所知並回答問題；所有人對公司面臨的風險感到擔憂，尤其強烈關注Jensen是否能回歸。見面的包括長期員工和新入職員工，全都支持Jensen；一些人質疑婚外情指控是否屬實，無法想像沒有他的NVIDIA並希望他回歸。另一擔憂是可能失去被此事動搖的長期員工，對他們而言在Jensen領導的創新公司工作的意義超過金錢。今日訪問期間安全似乎更嚴格，客人訪問限制為每月一次。訪問強調NVIDIA對Jensen本人尤其是其技術領導的依賴；撇開私人生活，他的回歸將是對NVIDIA最好的結果。

2121333811971547237.en_summary: AMD $AMD has two major product releases converging at the same time: Venice CPUs and the highly anticipated Helios MI400 Series. Three months ago management expected server CPU revenue to grow more than 70% in 2027 and total Data Center revenue “well over 100%” driven by the Helios ramp. AMD has raised its outlook considerably. Server CPU revenue now expected to more than double in 2027; Data Center AI revenue (GPUs) expected to significantly more than double. Companywide revenue guided to increase more than 80% next year, more than twice the long-term growth model. Data Center AI business expected to surpass server CPU business in revenue for the first time in Q4 as Helios enters a multi-gigawatt cycle with Anthropic, $META, $MSFT, OpenAI and $ORCL. Refers to July 2024 prediction that AMD’s returns would surpass $NVDA; since then AMD has gained more than 250% vs Nvidia’s 51%, outperforming by about 5X, with a hunch the gap could widen.
2121333811971547237.zh_summary: AMD $AMD有兩項主要產品同時發布：Venice CPU和備受期待的Helios MI400系列。三個月前管理層預期2027年伺服器CPU收入增長超過70%，數據中心總收入因Helios爬坡而「遠超100%」。此後AMD大幅上調展望。伺服器CPU收入現預期2027年超過翻倍；數據中心AI收入（GPU）預期顯著超過翻倍。公司整體收入指引明年增長超過80%，是長期增長模型的兩倍以上。數據中心AI業務預期在第四季首次在收入上超過伺服器CPU業務，因為Helios進入與Anthropic、$META、$MSFT、OpenAI和$ORCL的多吉瓦週期。提及2024年7月預測AMD回報將超過$NVDA；此後AMD上漲超過250%，而英偉達51%，跑贏約5倍，並有預感差距可能擴大。
